description: This file contains test cases for the 'passthrough' endpoints, specifically testing the integration with an external rerank API using aiohttp and pytest. It includes setup for environment variables, an asynchronous function to send requests to a local API, and a pytest test case to verify the reranking response.

methods.name: cohere_rerank(session)
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a POST request to a local rerank API endpoint with a predefined query and documents, returning the JSON response.

methods.name: test_basic_passthrough()
methods.description: A pytest asynchronous test case that invokes the 'cohere_rerank' function and asserts expected keys in the response.
